Sunday Social Ride from Queens Gardens

Croydon, United Kingdom · Croydon · Social · Mixed

Sunday Social Ride from Queens Gardens is a social group ride in Croydon, United Kingdom. It rolls every Sunday at 10:00 am local time from Queens Gardens, opposite Fairfield Halls. About 32 km (20 miles), easy, social, café stop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: easy, social, café stop.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sunday Social Ride from Queens Gardens group ride

Adult social rides of 15 to 30 miles that avoid hard climbs and prefer river trails, waterways, woodland and parks. The pace is easy and there is a café stop. Most rides start in Queens Gardens; some start elsewhere in south or east London.
